items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: He had John Pisano. The other guys were all there.

ctx.x: Right, so this is off the “Reunion” album. And you had just about, let’s see, for the exception of one fellow, this was the original —
Except for Jim Hall. He had John Pisano. The other guys were all there. But Jim wouldn’t go, he didn’t want to go back.
He didn’t want to go back to re-visit something.
